description.value: A voxel-based morphometry study examined grey matter volume changes associated with treatment as usual and adjunctive working-memory training in male in-patients being treated for methamphetamine use.

spans.text: This voxel-based morphometry (VBM) study is the first to examine whether 4 weeks of standard psychological intervention with additional adjunctive working memory (WM) training can alter brain volume in male in-patients being treated for methamphetamine (MA) use.

description.value: The study recruited male methamphetamine users and healthy controls, with MA patients alternated into treatment-as-usual and cognitive-training groups; MRI was acquired at baseline and 4-week follow-up.
